sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Emoji with Friends are simple yet addictive. The game requires you to create words from a set of given letters, but with a twist - you'll be using emojis to represent the words. The game starts with a set of emojis that are displayed on the screen, and you'll have to combine them to form valid words. The words can be as short as three letters or as long as seven letters. The game gets progressively harder as you level up, and the emojis become more complex and challenging to combine.

One of the unique features of Emoji with Friends is its ability to use emojis to represent words. This adds a whole new level of creativity to the game, as you'll have to think outside the box to come up with valid combinations of emojis. The game also features a hint system, which can be used to get a nudge in the right direction. However, be careful not to use the hint too much, as it will deduct from your overall score.

The game also features a timer, which adds an extra layer of pressure to the game. You'll have to solve levels as quickly as possible to get the highest score. The game also features a leaderboard, where you can compete with friends and other players to get to the top.

Overall, the core gameplay mechanics of Emoji with Friends are engaging, addictive, and fun. The game requires you to think creatively and strategically to solve levels, making it a great puzzle game for players of all ages.
